The project budget totals €312,249, but significant risks threaten cost certainty. Critical high-severity issues include a missing formwork position for the 140 m³ foundation slab (€4,256), creating ambiguity on whether formwork is included in the concrete price. Additionally, trench support specifications (€3,288) contain contradictory instructions and undefined terms, violating VOB/A clarity requirements.

Medium-severity findings involve vague site facility scopes, ambiguous pipe installation terminology, and imprecise thickness descriptions. These ambiguities program disputes during settlement. Although the bitumen/diesel price escalation clause carries no direct cost, it may be legally unreasonable under § 307 BGB. Immediate clarification of formwork inclusion and trench support definitions is essential to mitigate financial and legal exposure before contract award.
